design.kind: diffuse, perfectly isolated, off-catalogue dotted field
design.why: the only shape with receipts: 8 family submissions at M=37.7-42.3k with ~300 m nearest-neighbour spacing scored 0.2376-0.2778; every field at M>=60k with 100-224 m spacing scored <=0.2477; the field that sat ON the published fault maps scored 0.0360 (worst in the set)
design.lattice: integer hex, rows every 3 px, 1 px stagger -> every pair >= 300 m
design.ordering: nine-band evidence consensus (p90 flags) then a fixed-seed key

isolation_mass.note: C = sum over the footprint of the 300 m kernel of the dot set; C/M is the feature with the strongest positive rank correlation to reported score (rho = +0.55, n = 42). The champion measured 8.04, h34 8.42.

instruments.note: SGMC-off-catalogue credit is ANTI-correlated with reported scores (rho = -0.615, n = 42) and the field that maximised it scored 0.0360; recorded for the audit only, never as a promotion gate.

expectation.basis: 8 receipts at this mass/spacing: 0.2376, 0.2449, 0.2600, 0.2632, 0.2649, 0.2708 (x2), 0.2750, 0.2778; two same-shape counterexamples at 0.0778 and 0.0041 whose cause the receipts cannot identify
expectation.why: no in-repo instrument survives audit: SGMC proxy rho -0.615 (inverted); geometry/isolation explains at most rho +0.55 and is contradicted by two same-shape fields; lane-11c loci are worse than a uniform cell from the same datum band (0.81x).
